description: The G2P network's words from the books listeners hear (picovox_train/g2p.py load_data, every stage; python -m picovox_train.g2p book counts a book): labels - pronunciations of the books' words the dictionary lacks or has wrong (a dictionary word's label replaced, its rule-labeled forms following): names as well-established English pronunciations (anglicized Spanish as American readers say it, CMUdict's own convention - QUIXOTE K IY0 HH OW1 T IY0, SENOR S IY2 N Y AO1 R) and the archaic and British words' standard pronunciations, each a dictionary word in training; books - each book's word counts (the front end's words that train: the dictionary's, the labels', and their possessives - a possessive the dictionary lacks takes its stem's target with its -s suffix), frequency weights with g2p-words.json weightCounts
